title: Museum Game
desc: An educational museum you can walk through. Exhibits are interactive and short quizzes turn the visit into a game.
features: Walkable 3D museum with exhibits modelled in Blender
Hand-painted menu and an outdoor area
Quizzes and a small story that guide you through the exhibits
Tested with real users and improved based on their feedback
challenge: The goal was to make learning fun without dumbing down the content. Pacing rewards and revealing exhibits step by step kept players curious.
